changelog:
Initial release: Complete QA & Test Engineering Command Center.

- Covers test strategy, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing best practices.
- Provides templates for test planning, risk-based allocation, and detailed coverage analysis.
- Includes checklists for unit and integration tests, mocking guidelines, and test naming conventions.
- Offers guidance on managing flaky tests and structuring E2E user journey validation.
- Designed to be stack-agnostic and suitable for teams of any size.
summary: Comprehensive QA system for planning strategy, writing tests, analyzing coverage, automating pipelines, performance and security testing, defect triage, and...
